title: The Genetic Variants Influencing Hypertension Prevalence Based on the Risk of Insulin Resistance as Assessed Using the Metabolic Score for Insulin Resistance (METS-IR).
authors: Shine BK, Choi JE, Park YJ, Hong KW.
figures: Miami plots. The results of the genome-wide association study (GWAS) analyzing the risk of hypertension prevalence in the first tertile (T1, blue graph) and third tertile (T3, red graph) groups based on METS-IR are presented in the Miami plots. The horizontal axis represents the position of SNPs across chromosomes 1 to 22, and the vertical axis shows the −log10 transformation of the  p -values for
tables: Lead SNPs of the genome-wide significant associations with hypertension prevalence for each METS-IR group.
